input.title: Animation: Continue parent hover highlight pulse after drop
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
- b
- c
- d
- e
```

Drag and drop `a` into `d`.

## Current Behavior

The parent hover highlight pulse animation of `d` stops immediately on drop.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cce01bb1-0608-4f19-8722-c90b98c47a64

## Expected Behavior

The animation should continue for `verySlowDuration` before stopping. The pulse should also switch to a slower rate.
